description: D1: a reordering disturbs NOTHING but the moved row's place — placed items keep their positions, and the answer names the item as it now stands (`position` 2). `done` and `running` rows hold their positions like everything else; the queue is the backlog, not a graveyard to sweep. This answers with the row, never a re-render of the whole board — the board is queue.list's job (one method, one fact).

item.goal: Backfill the audit column for pre-S20 rows
